{"reason":"Change the medium/high fallback from alternative-supplier to alert-planner. This converts 34 costly switches into $35,000 always-in-time alerts; estimated cost falls from $2,165,000 to $1,225,000 and stockouts from 4 to 0 (fitness -2.565 to -1.225). It fixes the medium 5.3- and 2.8-day rows, each costing $195,000 with a stockout because the alternate supplier arrived late.","source":"(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'high))
          (< inventory-days 5))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    (else (list 'monitor))))"}
